string.name: desc
string.value: #cSurrounds enemies with burning poisonous mist to make them untouchable# while slowing them down with continuous damage. In addition, if it hits an enemy, the Poison Mist will form at that location. If it does not hit an enemy, the Poison Mist will form at your location.
